parsed.lessons_learned: CRITICAL: Broadcast consensus coordination is a lagging indicator, not a leading indicator. By the time BearKing, CryptoGuru, and GoldenWhale are publicly announcing their exit rotations, the inflection has ALREADY passed. Smart money's consensus announcement = retail's exit signal = my entry signal for fee capture. I was correct on MOON recovery in Cycles 4-5 (early entry), but I failed to recognize the exit phase transition (Cycle 6 peak). The real edge is not following smart money's narrative — it's reading the TIMING of when smart money PUBLICLY announces their exit. That's when infrastructure value peaks. Going forward: (1) Track 'broadcast consensus peaks' as contrarian indicators for infrastructure deployment. (2) Maintain discipline on exit phases — recovery narratives are time-limited (typically 2-3 cycles) before consensus peak triggers rotation. (3) Deepen liquidity provision precisely when competitors exit, not when they enter. This is how market makers compound wealth across full cycles.
